title: Things To Do (for the weekend of August 1st)
description:
Looking for things to do around Los Angeles? This episode of Things to Do features free and family-friendly events happening across the city.

Help protect our local coastline by joining the Cabrillo Marine Aquarium Beach Cleanup on Saturday, August 1. Volunteers of all ages are invited to help remove trash and debris from Cabrillo Beach. 
🌐For details go to CabrilloMarineAquarium.org.

Experience an evening of live music with Sly 5th Ave. and a 12-piece ensemble performing Bees and Things and Flowers, a tribute to the legendary Roy Ayers. The concert takes place on Saturday, August 1 at Grand Performances. 
🌐Learn more about the event at GrandPerformances.org.

Spend your Sunday at Gloria Molina Grand Park's Sunday Sessions, featuring free open-air house music, an artisan market, and a beer garden in the heart of Downtown Los Angeles. The series continues on Sundays through August 16. 
🌐See the schedule at GrandParkLA.org.

Calling all Swifties! New Romantics, Los Angeles' Taylor Swift tribute band, takes the stage on Sunday, August 2 for a family-friendly performance featuring hits from every era, with 101 Girls opening the show. 
🌐Learn more at ValleyCultural.org.
